'''2001 Trinoc-Con tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention held at Trinoc-Con, Millennium Hotel, Durham, NC on 6 October 2001. It is known from Philip Marschall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3027">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-07-durham-10-6-01-trinoc-con-piles-galored3027/ durham-10-6-01-trinoc-con-piles-galore], DeckTech (Philip "WorldChamp" Marschall, 7 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-07-durham-10-6-01-trinoc-con-piles-galored3027/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Trinoc-Con, Millennium Hotel, Durham, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
